description: Original provider-handle-transition suite with both tests and unchanged assertions.
sourceRevisionNote: The reviewed capsule runner verifies source HEAD and both working-tree and pinned-revision bytes before every stage; mismatch refuses execution.
dependencyClosureNote: Runtime closure computed from the entry with source esbuild using bundle/write:false/platform:node/packages:external, then manually reviewed. It includes the test fixture and every first-party runtime-loaded module; type-only imports are intentionally absent because Vitest/esbuild erases them.
sourceVitestConfigDifferencesFromCapsule: The capsule retains Node environment but intentionally omits the source-wide ORCA_FEATURE_WALL_ENABLED define because this closure does not reference it.
The capsule omits the source-wide happy-dom canvas, MutationObserver-retention, and host-port setup files because these runtime suites use no DOM, canvas, MutationObserver, or host ports.
The capsule omits source-wide --no-experimental-webstorage and --expose-gc worker flags because these suites observe neither Web Storage nor GC timing.
The capsule uses Vitest defaults instead of source-wide 60000ms hook and 30000ms test timeouts; execution remains bounded externally by the reviewed runner.
Execution explicitly uses the source-installed Vitest 4.1.11 entry module; no version substitution is admitted.
isolationRationale: Pure in-memory record/lease/handle construction and transition. No filesystem, timers, network, process launch, credentials, provider/session contact, global mutation, or service effects.
